news.title: Tinubu Hails Flamingos After First U-17 World Cup Win
news.lede: President Bola Tinubu has congratulated Nigeria’s Flamingos for becoming the first African team to win the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. The Flamingos defeated Japan 2-1 in Saturday’s 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup final in Rabat, Morocco, to clinch Nigeria’s maiden title in the competition. The President, who received the cheering news upon his return from campaign engagements in Akwa Ibom and Rivers, described the triumph as a proud moment for Nigeria. He also described the victory as a landmark achievement for African women’s football.

news.title: World Cup final brawl: FIFA reduces Molina’s ban, upholds Paredes’ suspension
news.lede: The FIFA Appeals Chamber has reduced Argentina defender Nahuel Molina’s suspension from seven matches to four, while upholding the 10-match ban imposed on midfielder Leandro Paredes following disciplinary incidents during Spain’s World Cup celebrations. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) announced the decisions on Friday night, confirming that Molina’s punishment had been reduced following an appeal. The right-back, who was initially handed a seven-match suspension for punching Rodri during Spain’s celebrations after their 1-0 World Cup final victory, will now serve a four-match ban and pay a fine of $60,000. However, Paredes failed to secure a reduction in his punishment.

news.title: Nigeria Crowned U17 Women’s World Cup Champions After 2-1 Win Over Japan in Morocco
news.lede: Rabat – Nigeria won the FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026 after defeating Japan 2-1 in the final on Saturday at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Sale. The Nigerian side secured the trophy through goals from Owao Bashiru and Oluyebube Omoijako, while Fuki Ito scored Japan’s only goal. Nigeria took the lead in the 39th minute when Bashiru found the back of the net, giving her team a 1-0 advantage before half-time. The African side maintained its attacking momentum after the break, with Omoijako doubling the lead just two minutes into the second half, putting Nigeria in a strong position to secure the title.
